summary: All three blocking findings are valid and should be repaired in spec.json before gate.

items.title: Review history scope omits existing review phases
items.rationale: The spec claims review phase aggregation and adjacent-attempt repair metrics, but the history persistence requirement only names impl/spec latest artifacts. The repair should define the exact phases and artifact basenames included in attempt history.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2], requirements[3], and tasks[1] mention review artifacts and review phases without listing draft/test review artifacts or explicit exclusions.

items.title: Finding identity and category contract is missing
items.rationale: Repair correspondence and same-category metrics require stable finding ids and a normalized category source. The repair should require normalized attempt-level finding records with id and category fields plus unknown fallbacks.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[2], requirements[4], requirements[5], and requirements[6] depend on finding id/category behavior without defining the normalized contract.

items.title: Attempt-limit source misses review retry state
items.rationale: Attempt-limit reporting cannot rely only on issue-log entries because review retry state is also stored in flow metrics. The repair should add flow.json retry state as an input for review/gate attempt-limit detection.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[1], requirements[5], and overview.data_flow only mention issue-log/review artifacts for attempt-limit reporting.
